issues.title: Judge Dredd featured in most progs (issues) of 2000 AD. It may look like a lot but keep in mind each prog usually only has 6 pages of Judge Dredd story. It is recommended to read the stories in a collected format. The reading order is listed by collection, further broken down into individual progs.
This reading order contains only the most highly recommended and/or major Judge Dredd stories.
Alternatively The Cursed Earth story can be found collected in The Cursed Earth Uncensored (2016). This volume includes 4 progs that were left out of the Complete Case Files #2 for copyright reasons.
